result.summary: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover boundary conditions and untested edge cases in src/script/script.cpp. The additions exercise CScript::IsPayToTaproot(), CScript::IsPayToAnchor(), CScript::GetSigOpCount(), CScript::HasValidOps(), CScriptWitness::ToString(), and truncated pushdata parsing in CScript::GetOp().
result.problem: Boundary conditions and error branches in core script functions are not covered by unit tests, allowing synthetic mutations in src/script/script.cpp to survive without triggering test failures.
evidence: PR description documents 12 specific live mutants across src/script/script.cpp and provides the failing BOOST assertion for each mutant.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased or adjusted commit metadata; the substantive test coverage and target functions remain identical to the previous version.
result.card: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover boundary conditions and kill 12 live mutants in src/script/script.cpp identified through mutation testing. The additions exercise edge cases in Taproot and Anchor recognition, SigOp counting boundary opcodes, opcode validation limits in HasValidOps, truncated pushdata payloads in GetOp, and witness stack string formatting. Only test files are touched.

risk.why: Only unit tests are added, so a mistake cannot affect node behavior or consensus.
